name: Hades
description: Heavy lumbering walk in place facing the viewer, alternate thick legs with slow weighty footsteps, shoulders rock, belly and chains sway, keep one hooked blade in each hand. Seamless cycle. Preserve the exact source sprite identity, outfit, weapons, size and crisp pixel art palette. All motion fits inside the canvas. Fixed front orthographic camera, no translation, no rotation of camera, no zoom, transparent background.
